candidate.name: heat-tree
candidate.license: MIT (declared; no LICENSE file in tarball)
candidate.notes: d3 SVG widget with its own toolbar inside a shadow root; no callbacks, so click/hover/colour/highlight/focus are adapter workarounds on its DOM.

tipClick.how: No callback. A capture listener on the open shadow root reads the d3 datum (__data__) of the library's own .tip-hit path; emitted tip set is adapter-derived from the shared TreeModel. The library also shows its selection box and action buttons (collapse, hide, rotate).

internalNodeClick.how: No callback and no node markers. Clicking inside a clade selects the deepest .hit region (a clade-sized rectangle or wedge); read from the d3 datum via the shadow root. The click point for a node is the strip between the node and its first child.

branchClick.how: Branches are not clickable; only the clade-sized hit areas are. A branch click selects the clade region, which is reported as nodeClick.

hover.how: mouseover on .hit / .tip-hit read from the shadow root; tip sets adapter-derived. Hover over a clade region reports the deepest enclosing clade (no per-branch hover).

descendantTipsInPayload.how: The library emits nothing. Tip sets are computed by the adapter from the shared TreeModel (source adapter-derived).

cladeColouring.how: No API. Adapter sets inline stroke on the library's branch paths and fill (important) on tip-label text, derived from d3 datums, and re-applies after TreeState coordinateChange. Elements created later by expanding a collapsed clade are styled after the next redraw.

highlightTip.how: No API. A class on the library's tip-label <text> (bold, primary colour, soft halo via paint-order stroke); no marker or row band. Applies to rendered labels only.

focusTip.how: No API. Applies a d3-zoom transform through TreeView.treeZoom (public but undocumented field) centred on the tip with label size at least 18 px; instant.

tipAsLink.how: The library draws SVG text only. HTML <a href data-tip-id tabindex=0> overlay positioned over up to 400 visible tip labels, repositioned on every zoom event (d3-zoom namespaced listener).

customColumns.how: No aligned columns. The first text column drives tipLabelColor (categorical, GBIF palette) and the first bar column drives tipLabelSize (continuous), through TreeData.addTable + TreeState.setAesthetics (the library's own per-field mapping). The "cell" is the tip label.

alignmentColumn.how: No sequence or alignment rendering; only label colour, size, font, style and text can be mapped to metadata.

radialLayout.how: TreeState.setLayout('circular'); real polar layout with rotated labels.

branchLengthToggle.how: No cladogram mode. Adapter rewrites node.data.length on the d3 hierarchy (height difference, tips aligned) and calls TreeState.update(); original lengths are restored for the phylogram. Trees without lengths get synthetic lengths.

scaleBar.how: A branch-length scale legend is always drawn under the tree.

darkTheme.how: Library CSS custom properties (--color-background, --color-text ...) and branch/label/legend rules overridden by a <style> appended to the open shadow root. The built-in toolbar follows the variables and color-scheme; colours set by metadata mappings stay as mapped.

cssTokens.how: Page CSS cannot reach into the shadow root (default isolation). Values from gbifTheme() are passed as custom properties on the host and consumed by an adapter-supplied <style> in the shadow root. isolation:'none' exists but injects the library's global stylesheet into the page.

multipleInstances.how: Each heatTree() call attaches its own shadow root; no module singletons found. Each call also appends a hidden 5000x5000 measurement container to document.body (removed by the adapter on unmount).

cleanUnmount.how: No destroy(). Adapter removes the host, calls TreeView.destroy(), detaches its listeners and removes the library's hidden <div> from document.body. The library's ResizeObserver is not exposed and is left to garbage collection with the detached element.

controlledState.how: Layout is a TreeState method; everything else (colour, highlight, lengths, columns) goes through adapter workarounds. No props, no update(options): options are read once at heatTree().

zoomToFit.how: Fits on mount, on layout change and on container resize (ResizeObserver, 100 ms debounce); TreeView.fitToView() and the autoZoom/autoPan options (Default, Both, X, Y, None).

overviewOrMinimap.how: None. Collapse (triangle) of clades is manual through the selection buttons; no level of detail by zoom.

caveat: Headless Chromium without a GPU (SwiftShader software rendering): absolute FPS for canvas and WebGL candidates is pessimistic; use for functional tests and relative comparison. Final scale numbers need a real browser on a normal laptop.

thresholds.note: unusable = load > 10 s, or > 50% of the time in frames > 50 ms (best of 3 rounds), or > 100 ms main-thread CPU per interaction step, or click latency > 300 ms; p5 FPS is reported (best of 3) but not judged

load.note: os.loadavg()[0] (1-minute); runs with start or end load above 4 are marked noisy
